description: This file contains the PHP class 'Search' in the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace. The class provides methods related to managing customer search data, specifically an 'addSearch' method that inserts search keywords into the database.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: A model class that handles adding customer search records into the database.

methods.name: addSearch
methods.description: Adds a new customer search entry into the 'customer_search' table with details like store ID, language ID, customer ID, keyword, category ID, sub-category flag, description flag, products flag, IP address, and timestamp.
